lead.description: assignment of a numerical value by a procedure that has a scatter and may sit off the quantity it aims at

overview_sentence: [Measurement](articles/measurement.qmd) assigns a number by a procedure that can scatter and can sit off the quantity it aims at.

self_checks.title: Two operators
self_checks.prompt: Operator A's times 10, 12, 11, and 11 have mean 11. The true duration is 12. What is A's bias?

self_checks.title: One more time
self_checks.prompt: A's times gain a fifth value of 16, and the true duration stays 12. What are the new mean and the new bias?
self_checks.answer: The mean is 12 and the bias is 0.
